record.paper_title: Open problems on classical de Sitter solutions
record.original_question: Do there exist any classical 10-dimensional string backgrounds with a 4-dimensional de Sitter spacetime, D-brane sources, and orientifold sources in which all sources are parallel, or is every such classical de Sitter solution with parallel sources impossible?

evidence.quote:
Classical 10d string backgrounds with a 4d de Sitter space-time, D-brane and orientifold sources, are commonly believed to satisfy the following:
1. There is no classical de Sitter solution with parallel sources.
Conjecture 1 There is no classical de Sitter solution with parallel sources.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider classical 10-dimensional string backgrounds in type II supergravity, of the warped-product form $\mathrm{dS}_4 \times_w \mathcal{M}_6$, where $\mathrm{dS}_4$ is 4-dimensional de Sitter spacetime and $\mathcal{M}_6$ is a compact 6-dimensional manifold. Allow the background to contain D$p$-brane sources and orientifold O$p$-plane sources, with their fluxes, treated at the level of the classical (two-derivative, tree-level) supergravity action with localized source terms. Say that the sources are "parallel" if all D-brane and O-plane sources wrap the same internal cycle, i.e. their internal worldvolume directions coincide (as opposed to being intersecting or smeared on different cycles).

Question: Does there exist any such classical solution (for any $p$) with all sources parallel and a strictly positive 4-dimensional cosmological constant, or is it the case that no classical de Sitter solution with parallel D-brane and O-plane sources exists?
artifact.status_search_result: The statement "there is no classical de Sitter solution with parallel sources" is a widely-believed conjecture supported by strong no-go theorems that exclude p = 3, 7, 8 and place tight constraints on p = 4, 5, 6. However, no general proof is known, and researchers continue to identify regions of parameter space where counterexamples could potentially exist. Active research through 2024 has not settled the conjecture. The problem is therefore considered open.

status_evidence.title: Open problems on classical de Sitter solutions
status_evidence.snippet: Conjecture 1: There is no classical de Sitter solution with parallel sources.
status_evidence.claim: The non-existence of classical de Sitter solutions with parallel sources is stated as an open conjecture.

status_evidence.title: Refining the boundaries of the classical de Sitter landscape
status_evidence.snippet: vacua for p = 3, 7 or 8 are completely excluded, and tight constraints are obtained for p = 4, 5, 6.
status_evidence.claim: Partial no-go results exclude several values of p but do not prove the full conjecture.

status_evidence.title: Almost classical de Sitter?
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2024) study of classical-dS scenarios in type II string theories with corrections to brane/O-plane actions.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture remains an active research topic as of 2024 with no full proof.
